commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a0221e906e694e2f2554e21c307f8fe603e218a1"
APK='app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'
test -s "$APK"
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'
SHIZUKU='moe.shizuku.privileged.api'
adb start-server >/dev/null
adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'
adb -s "$SEL" install --no-streaming -r "$APK"
for P in android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS; do
  adb -s "$SEL" shell pm grant "$PKG" "$P"
done
BASE="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell pm path "$SHIZUKU" | head -1 | sed 's/^package://' | tr -d '\r')"
ROOT="$(dirname "$BASE")"
STARTER="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell find "$ROOT/lib" -type f -name libshizuku.so 2>/dev/null | head -1 | tr -d '\r')"
test -n "$STARTER"
adb -s "$SEL" shell "$STARTER"
sleep 3
adb -s "$SEL" shell ps -A | grep -q shizuku_server
adb -s "$SEL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f shared_prefs/debug_auto_clir_bootstrap.xml shared_prefs/campaign_runtime_status_v1.xml
adb -s "$SEL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"
adb -s "$SEL" shell input keyevent 224 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
adb -s "$SEL" shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
adb -s "$SEL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, subprocess, time, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
SEL="192.168.0.100:46769"
TARGET_PACKAGE="moe.shizuku.privileged.api"
TARGET_ID="moe.shizuku.privileged.api:id/button1"

def run(args, timeout=10):
    p=subprocess.run(args,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=timeout,check=False)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout.replace("\r","")

deadline=time.time()+20
clicked=False
while time.time()<deadline:
    _,focus=run(["adb","-s",SEL,"shell","dumpsys","window","windows"],10)
    run(["adb","-s",SEL,"shell","uiautomator","dump","/sdcard/aicall-shizuku-permission.xml"],10)
    _,xml=run(["adb","-s",SEL,"shell","cat","/sdcard/aicall-shizuku-permission.xml"],10)
    if TARGET_PACKAGE not in focus and TARGET_PACKAGE not in xml:
        time.sleep(0.5)
        continue
    try:
        root=ET.fromstring(xml[xml.find("<?xml"):])
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(0.5)
        continue
    node=None
    for candidate in root.iter("node"):
        if candidate.attrib.get("resource-id")==TARGET_ID:
            node=candidate
            break
    if node is None:
        time.sleep(0.5)
        continue
    bounds=node.attrib.get("bounds","")
    m=re.fullmatch(r"\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]",bounds)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit("shizuku_allow_bounds_invalid")
    x1,y1,x2,y2=map(int,m.groups())
    x=(x1+x2)//2; y=(y1+y2)//2
    code,out=run(["adb","-s",SEL,"shell","input","tap",str(x),str(y)],10)
    if code!=0:
        raise SystemExit("shizuku_allow_tap_failed")
    print("shizuku_permission_allow_clicked=true",flush=True)
    clicked=True
    break
if not clicked:
    print("last_focus="+focus.replace("\n"," ")[:600],flush=True)
    print("last_ui="+xml.replace("\n"," ")[:1000],flush=True)
    raise SystemExit("shizuku_permission_dialog_not_found")
PY
sleep 2
adb -s "$SEL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"
sleep 1
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.calls.live_call_readiness --serial "$SEL"
